rules.l1: largest B in 0..16 (step 4) with swap-from-B transfer >= 0.90
rules.ls: single layer with the largest transfer (ties: earlier)
rules.la,s_add: largest change-to-injected rate with answer retention >= 0.90 (ties: first in grid)
rules.s_kl: random-direction scale (x base_norm) whose median R-KL equals the training swap's (log-log interpolation)
rules.lr: higher acc_diff + acc_same on pilot half B (ties: lower lr)
